row.evidence: airfocus's pricing page lists SCIM provisioning under Enterprise ('Everything on Professional, plus'), and its Okta SAML and SCIM guide says 'This functionality is available to all customers with an airfocus Enterprise plan subscription.'
row.notes: New row. airfocus is now 'airfocus by Lucid' with two quote-only plans, Professional and Enterprise; help moved to help.lucid.co. SAML SSO is a paid add-on on Professional (price not published) and included on Enterprise; SCIM is Enterprise only. The pricing comparison table marks Enterprise SCIM as 'Soon' while the plan card and help centre say it is included (recorded in conflicts). SCIM guides exist for Okta, Entra ID and PingIdentity (custom apps, base URL + bearer token), with role provisioning via the roles attribute and group push. SAML JIT adds first-time users as Contributors. REST API (bearer tokens, 600 req/min) can list, invite, disable, remove users and change roles; plan gate conflicts between pricing table (Professional) and help centre (Enterprise).

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: SAML SSO (Google, Azure, Okta via SAML) is a paid add-on on Professional; price not published. Pricing table checks Open APIs on Professional, but the help centre says API access is Enterprise only (see conflicts).

scim.base_url: Shown in Team settings > Security/SSO after Enable SCIM (pattern not published)

auth.token_source: Team settings > Security/SSO > Enable SCIM (base URL, team ID and generated token)

deprovision.notes: Okta's Deactivate Users action is enabled; the docs do not describe what airfocus does with the account or seat.

attributes.notes: Only userName (unique identifier) and the roles attribute (roles[type eq contributor|editor|admin].value in the core User schema) are named; no full attribute list is published.

roles.how: Core-schema roles attribute with type contributor, editor or admin, mapped from custom Okta boolean profile attributes; highest role wins, default Contributor.

limitations.text: No password sync; SCIM-provisioned users must sign in via SAML SSO.
Changing the Okta username (rather than email) creates a new user in airfocus.
No catalogue apps: Okta uses a custom SAML app integration and Entra a non-gallery app.
Entra provisioning can take around 40 minutes.

scim.notes: SCIM docs cover Okta, Microsoft Entra ID and PingIdentity, all using the airfocus SCIM base URL and bearer token, so status is not partial.

capabilities.notes: delete_user = POST /api/team/users/kick (remove from team); deactivate/reactivate via POST /api/team/users/disabled. Admin role required for writes.

endpoints.purpose: Send a user invite (scope team, admin)
Remove a user from the team

rate_limits.text: Default 600 requests per minute per authenticated client, reported in X-RateLimit-* headers.

okta.notes: okta.com/integrations/airfocus/ returns 404; airfocus documents a custom SAML 2.0 app with SCIM provisioning.

entra.notes: No Entra gallery tutorial (404); airfocus documents a non-gallery app with SAML and SCIM.

conflicts.text: The pricing page's Enterprise card lists 'SCIM provisioning' as included, but the same page's comparison table shows SCIM provisioning as 'Soon' for Enterprise (cross for Professional); the help centre says SAML and SCIM are available on Enterprise. Docs used for behaviour: SCIM treated as available on Enterprise.
The pricing comparison table checks 'Open APIs' on both Professional and Enterprise, while the help centre says API access is available to Enterprise customers.
